## About the Event

IGNITO’ 26is the premier annual symposium hosted by the Mechanical Engineering students of MGIT. It is a dynamic intersection of disciplines where mechanical precision meets electronic intelligence. Each year, we open our doors to students from across the region to compete in a high-energy mix of technical challenges and creative non-technical events. From robotics and design to strategic gaming, IGNITO’ 26 is a platform for talent to shine, ideas to collide, and the next generation of engineers to connect.
